A madeira clara traz conforto, a luz natural é aproveitada ao máximo, e cada solução, desde a arrumação invisível aos eletrodomésticos embutidos, tudo contribui para um espaço eficiente, sereno e pronto a viver.

programme.title: As Receitas Simples De Mary T2 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Numa tentativa de manter as coisas simples e as listas de compras curtas, Mary confecciona pratos saborosos compostos por apenas alguns ingredientes.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott - Ep. 13
programme.desc: O especialista em imobiliário e empreiteiro Scott McGillivray oferece o melhor roteiro para a renovação e o sucesso do aluguer em Scott´s Vacation House Rules.

programme.title: Comer Pelo Mundo T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Programa de viagens gastronómicas apresentado por Verónica Zumalacárregui que nos traz a cozinha de cidades de todo o mundo ao entrar em contacto com os protagonistas locais que acabam por funcionar como cicerones de exceção.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T1 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Billy e Gwendoline têm as mãos cheias: pedem ajuda a Dick para instalar um candeeiro de teto e, depois, têm de localizar javalis selvagens que estão a causar o caos dentro e à volta da mansão.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T1 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Hoje, na mansão de Billy e Gwendoline, Billy e o seu pai tentam nivelar um pátio para que cumpra as normas de saúde e segurança; mais fácil de dizer do que fazer num edifício do século XVIII.

programme.title: As Receitas Simples De Mary T1 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: Mary mostra como atender às intolerâncias e alergias alimentares, aumentando o sabor em vez de utilizar substituições de ingredientes.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T3 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Construída no início dos anos 70, a casa de campo Muskoka do pai de Anita tem ossos fortes, mas está muito ultrapassada.

programme.title: Ó Da Casa T1 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Programa dedicado à cozinha, Joana mostra como é fácil transformar os armários desta divisão e ter uma decoração completamente diferente. E porque a funcionalidade é muito importante neste espaço, vai ainda construir de raiz um móvel muito versátil.

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Os Baeumler preparam a abertura do Caerula Mar Club.

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Com o hotel encerrado devido à COVID-19, a família Baeumler está em quarentena na ilha. Bryan e Sarah têm de adaptar os seus planos empresariais e familiares à realidade da pandemia.

programme.title: Personaliza A Tua Casa T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: No trabalho dos artesãos mais criativos Sofia Pereira encontra a inspiração para em cada episódio nos mostrar 3 propostas decorativas.

programme.title: Personaliza A Tua Casa T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: No trabalho dos artesãos mais criativos Sofia Pereira encontra a inspiração para em cada episódio nos mostrar 3 propostas decorativas.

programme.title: Cozinhas Sem Limites Com Gordon Ramsay - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Esta noite, Gordon ensina-nos mais dos seus pratos favoritos de cozedura lenta. As receitas incluem deliciosos peitos de borrego recheados e estufados lentamente.

programme.title: Interior Design Masters Season T6 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Os nove designers trabalham num design sustentável, ao transformarem contentores e, escritórios para start-ups, em Bristol, com materiais reciclados e reaproveitados.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T2 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Continuamos esta volta a Portugal explorando as melhores iguarias. O destino do episódio de hoje é Vila Real. A chef Marlene Vieira apresenta-nos duas propostas de pastéis: uma salgada e uma doce. Os primeiros são os famosos pastéis de chaves e os segundos são os pitos de Santa Luzia. Delicie-se com estas propostas.

programme.title: Ó Da Casa T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Joana idealizou dois projetos bem distintos entre si para decorar o seu quarto. Começa por ensinar a fazer uma cabeceira de cama com uma esquadria de ripas e, depois, apresenta um projeto de transformação de um abajur antigo.

programme.title: Ó Da Casa T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Para este espaço, tantas vezes esquecido, a anfitriã Joana Laranjeira surpreende com novos projetos úteis e criativos - um móvel à medida dos cantos mal-aproveitados e soluções de iluminação e arrumação para quem não quer fazer furações.

programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos T2 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: John atira-se de cabeça na combinação italiana dos seus sonhos em Pittsburgh, na Pensilvânia: gnocchi caseiros fofos a nadar numa tigela de pão à moda de Sorrentina cheia de molho.

programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos T2 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: John parte para a soalheira Miami, na Florida, para um manjar porto-riquenho digno da lista, onde lhe apresentam o poderoso mofongo: uma montanha deliciosa de puré de banana-da-terra com camarão fresquíssimo.

programme.title: As Receitas Simples De Mary T2 - Ep. 22
programme.desc: Mary prepara um cesto de piquenique com receitas fáceis de transportar. Prepara rillettes de salmão, salada de porta de frigorífico, empadas de galinha e termina com panna cotta de morango e queijo de cabra para a sobremesa.

programme.title: Cozinhas Sem Limites Com Gordon Ramsay - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Esta noite, Gordon ensina-nos mais dos seus pratos favoritos de cozedura lenta. As receitas incluem deliciosos peitos de borrego recheados e estufados lentamente.

programme.title: Passport Properties T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: No calcanhar da bota italiana, Billy Nash explora Puglia e a península de Salento, onde a paixão pela herança e pelo artesanato define o quotidiano.

programme.title: As Receitas Simples De Mary T2 - Ep. 24
programme.desc: Os tacos fazem de cada refeição um banquete. A Mary faz Carnitas de porco com especiarias mexicanas, envoltas em cerveja com citrinos frescos. Também faz Pico de Gallo, guacamole e tortilhas com uma crosta de queijo estaladiça, e brinda-as com Pineapple Spritz.

programme.title: As Receitas Simples De Mary T2 - Ep. 25
programme.desc: As refeições de Natal não são apenas para a família. Nesta época, a Mary partilha todas as receitas necessárias para organizar um fantástico convívio de férias com as melhores amigas. Comece a festa com uma travessa de Camembert assado, compota de arando e nozes com especiarias.

programme.title: Interior Design Masters Season T6 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Os nove designers trabalham num design sustentável, ao transformarem contentores e, escritórios para start-ups, em Bristol, com materiais reciclados e reaproveitados.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Tim e Rebecca recebem uma reserva e preparam-se para a chegada iminente dos seus primeiros hóspedes pagantes. É o grande teste para ver se estão preparados para a vida de BAndB.

programme.title: Passport Properties T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: No Reino Unido, Billy Nash explora o património, a criatividade e a vida moderna através das histórias daqueles que os definem.

programme.title: Renovation Resort T3 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Com a meta final à vista, as equipas enfrentam a última peça do puzzle das suas casas junto ao lago: uma ampla sala de estar, enquanto lidam com a pressão crescente, medos pessoais e um espaço surpresa que as leva ao limite.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T3 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Marlene Vieira junta conforto e delicadeza à mesma mesa, começando com uma Feijoada de Lula e Camarão, uma versão que mantém a alma reconfortante da feijoada, mas ganha frescura com os sabores do mar.Para terminar, a chef prepara Peras Bêbedas com Saké, uma reinvenção mais leve e floral da sobremesa clássica.

programme.title: Experiências.PT T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Um salto da maior ponte pedonal suspensa do mundo leva João Kopke até Arouca. Superará o desafio? Conheça esta e outras sugestões, no Experiências.pt.

programme.title: Eco Reset - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Vera Kolodzig e Fátima Lopes rumam à Serra da Esperança para descobrir o TheVagar, um refúgio pensado para abrandar e reconectar com a natureza. Entre experiências únicas, este episódio é o convite ideal para fugir da rotina e recarregar energias.

programme.title: Eco Reset - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A Tripeirinha junta-se a Vera Kolodzig para explorar o Craveiral Farmhouse, um refúgio alentejano em S. Teotónio. Numa escapadinha marcada pela simplicidade e sustentabilidade, descobrem um projeto que alia a vida no campo ao bem-estar.

programme.title: As Receitas Simples De Mary T3 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Tenham o melhor de dois mundos quando Mary mistura ideias para obter pratos invulgares como Frango Assado de Salada César e Almôndegas Taco na Frigideira.

programme.title: As Receitas Simples De Mary T3 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: O queijo está na lista restrita dos verdadeiros amores de Mary, por isso, é hora de mais uma rodada de 'tudo-com-queijo'! Entrada, pratos principais e sobremesa, valha-me Deus.

programme.title: Cozinhas Sem Limites Com Gordon Ramsay - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Esta noite, Gordon ensina-nos mais dos seus pratos favoritos de cozedura lenta. As receitas incluem deliciosos peitos de borrego recheados e estufados lentamente.

programme.title: Cozinhas Sem Limites Com Gordon Ramsay - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Esta noite, o curso de culinária de Gordon continua, enquanto ele nos ensina a preparar alguns dos seus brunches de eleição. As receitas incluem as suas irresistíveis panquecas picantes, uma frittata simples e deliciosa e um soufflé de três queijos infalível.

programme.title: Passport Properties T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Billy Nash mergulha a fundo e explora a Croácia, onde a história, a beleza e a ligação humana moldaram um dos destinos mais procurados do mundo quanto ao estilo de vida e a propriedade imobiliária.

programme.title: Irmãos Scott: Sob Pressão - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Naima e Edo vivem na casa herdada da avó, mas a falta de espaço e novos desafios familiares obrigam-nos a decidir entre remodelar a casa ou começar de novo. Jonathan e Drew ajudam-nos a escolher.

programme.title: Interior Design Masters Season T6 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Os 8 designers formam pares para transformarem apartamentos de luxo para reformados, em Portsmouth, com recurso às suas capacidades decorativas para convencerem “baby boomers” a comprarem a sua casa definitiva.

programme.title: Cozinhas À Medida T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Neste episódio, acompanhamos a transformação de uma cozinha que, mesmo não sendo antiga, pedia uma nova linguagem. O objetivo era claro: mais luz, mais organização e nada à vista!

programme.title: As Receitas Simples De Mary T2 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Mary prepara enchiladas de batata doce, feijão preto e tofu e Socca francesa com grão-de-bico. Depois, prepara uma salada com nozes e sementes, arandos e tiras de wonton estaladiças e pakoras vegetarianas.

programme.title: Comer Pelo Mundo T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Programa de viagens gastronómicas apresentado por Verónica Zumalacárregui que nos traz a cozinha de cidades de todo o mundo ao entrar em contacto com os protagonistas locais que acabam por funcionar como cicerones de exceção.

programme.desc: Programa de viagens gastronómicas apresentado por Verónica Zumalacárregui que nos traz a cozinha de cidades de todo o mundo ao entrar em contacto com os protagonistas locais que acabam por funcionar como cicerones de exceção. Neste episódio Verónica viaja até Moscovo.

programme.title: The World Today

programme.title: World Insight With Tian Wei
programme.desc: World Insight with Tian Wei is a long-running international platform for debate and intelligent discussion.

programme.title: Vendeta
programme.desc: Três amigos casados reúnem-se para um encontro anual de caça numa zona de deserto mas um deles traz consigo a jovem amante e a situação fica rapidamente fora de controlo. Deixada como morta no meio de um deserto infernal, a rapariga vai vingar-se e caçá-los um a um...

programme.title: Instinto Predador
programme.desc: Um navio grego transporta animais exóticos perigosos da Amazónia, incluindo um raro jaguar branco. Nessa mesma embarcação, um assassino, que estava a ser extraditado em segredo para os EUA, consegue fugir e libertar todos os animais em cativeiro, deixando os tripulantes em perigo de vida.

programme.title: À Margem Da Lei
programme.desc: Quando um ex-detective descobre que o filho foi assassinado, ele regressa às ruas que outrora tão bem conhecia para tentar saber a verdade. Armado, perigoso e sem nada a perder, ele vai enfrentar um implacável mafioso local na busca de vingança.

programme.title: Meia-noite Em Switchgrass
programme.desc: Dois agentes do FBI a investigar uma rede de tráfico sexual cruzam-se com uma série de casos de homicídios de mulheres na Florida. Quando uma missão infiltrada dá para o torto e a própria agente é raptada, um oficial daquele estado tem poucas horas para a libertar e apanhar o brutal criminoso.

programme.title: Marighella
programme.desc: É maoísta, trotskista ou leninista?´ Carlos Marighella só tem uma resposta para esta questão: ´Sou brasileiro´. Depois do golpe de Estado que derrubou um governo legitimamente eleito em 1964 e pôs uma ditadura militar no poder, Marighella conduz um grupo de jovens à resistência armada.

programme.title: O Mauritano
programme.desc: Mohamedou Ould Slahi é detido pelo governo dos EUA logo a seguir ao 11 de Setembro, e é encarcerado em Guantánamo sem julgamento durante anos. Os seus únicos aliados são a advogada de defesa Nancy Hollander e a sua associada Teri Duncan que tentam lutar por justiça e descobrir toda a verdade.

programme.title: Rio Bravo
programme.desc: O xerife John T. Chance prende o irmão de um poderoso rancheiro por homicídio e tem de o manter na cadeia até chegar o delegado federal. Cercado pelos pistoleiros pagos para o libertar, conta apenas com um ajudante alcoólico, um jovem atirador e um velho coxo para resistir.

programme.title: O Legado
programme.desc: O patriarca de uma família rica e poderosa morre subitamente, deixando à sua filha um chocante legado secreto, que ameaça destruir a sua vida…

programme.title: Os Estagiários
programme.desc: Billy e Nick são vendedores cujas carreiras foram destruídas pela era digital. Na tentativa de provar que não estão obsoletos, conseguem um cobiçado estágio na Google, juntamente com um batalhão de pequenos génios. O problema é que eles são quase info-excluídos…

programme.title: Sombras Da Escuridão
programme.desc: Barnabas Collins é um vampiro que, após ter sido enterrado vivo por 196 anos, regressa ao mundo dos vivos e à sua casa ancestral no Maine, onde encontra os seus descendentes absolutamente disfuncionais e a necessitar da sua proteção.

programme.title: Ousadas E Golpistas
programme.desc: Um grupo de strippers de Nova Iorque droga os homens de negócios de Wall Street que visitam o clube e depois rouba-lhes dinheiro do cartão de crédito, sabendo que eles não poderão ir à polícia sem denunciar que lá estiveram. Só que a prática alastra-se e o perigo torna-se muito real.

programme.title: O Chacal
programme.desc: Quando um impiedoso assassino conhecido como Chacal é contratado para eliminar um elemento importante do governo dos EUA, o diretor-adjunto do FBI vai resgatar à prisão um atirador do IRA para juntos deterem o misterioso mercenário antes que ele consiga levar a cabo a sua mortífera missão.

programme.title: O Torneio
programme.desc: Numa cidade no norte de Inglaterra, um torneio é assistido por dezenas de homens ricos, com 30 concorrentes que estão dispostos a tudo para ganhar um prémio de 10 milhões de dólares. O objetivo é simples: matar todos os adversários e ser o último sobrevivente de todos.

programme.title: O Segredo Do Refúgio
programme.desc: Dois casais alugam um refúgio perfeito à beira-mar, mas em pouco tempo o que deveria ser um fim de semana de descanso assume contornos sinistros…

programme.title: Duchess Implacável
programme.desc: Scarlett Monaghan, mais conhecida como Duchess, entra no submundo do contrabando de diamantes, torna-se a líder implacável de um grupo de crime organizado e vai fazer tudo para vingar a morte do homem que amou.

programme.title: O Homem Dos Punhos De Ferro 2
programme.desc: Quando Thaddeus, um estranho misterioso, recupera de ferimentos numa pequena vila na China do século XIX, envolve-se no conflito que coloca o povo do vilarejo contra o maldoso Mestre Ho e o nefasto clã Beetle. Com Thaddeus ao seu lado, o bem educado Li Kung transforma-se num guerreiro mortal.

programme.title: Parasitas
programme.desc: Uma família coreana no desemprego começa a ter um interesse peculiar por uma outra, com um estilo de vida cheio de glamour, até que todos se envolvem num acontecimento absolutamente inesperado.

programme.title: Le Chant Du Loup - Ameaça Em Alto Mar
programme.desc: Chanteraide tem o raro dom de conseguir identificar todos os sons que ouve. A bordo de um submarino nuclear francês, tudo depende dele, só que, reputado como infalível, ele acaba por cometer um erro que coloca toda a equipa em perigo de morte.

programme.title: Zona 414
programme.desc: Num futuro próximo, numa colónia de robôs humanoides, o detetive particular David Carmichael é contratado para encontrar a filha desaparecida do excêntrico criador dos andróides que integram aquela comunidade.

programme.title: No Lugar Errado
programme.desc: Um “cozinheiro” de metanfetaminas persegue o ex-chefe de polícia de uma pequena cidade a fim de o silenciar antes que ele testemunhe contra a sua família, só que acaba por ver-se confrontado com muito mais do que o que estava à espera.

programme.title: O Chacal
programme.desc: Quando um impiedoso assassino conhecido como Chacal é contratado para eliminar um elemento importante do governo dos EUA, o diretor-adjunto do FBI vai resgatar à prisão um atirador do IRA para juntos deterem o misterioso mercenário antes que ele consiga levar a cabo a sua mortífera missão.

programme.title: Missão Inesperada
programme.desc: Jim Hanson, um ex-atirador de elite do exército, vive junto à isolada fronteira entre os EUA e o México e torna-se inesperadamente o protetor de um menino mexicano, quando um perigoso cartel de droga mata a mãe do rapaz e os começa a perseguir de forma implacável.

programme.title: Na Corda Bamba
programme.desc: Há muito tempo, Rick Jarmin testemunhou contra um grupo de criminosos e desde então tem vivido escondido ao abrigo do Programa de Proteção de Testemunhas. Mas tudo se complica quando ele dá de caras com a antiga namorada, e ela reconhece-o...

programme.title: Backtrace Rasto De Violência
programme.desc: Após ficar ferido gravemente durante um assalto, MacDonald perde a memória e é colocado na ala psiquiátrica de uma prisão de alta segurança. Sete anos passados, é contactado por outro prisioneiro que lhe oferece ajuda para fugir da prisão…

programme.title: As Voltas Da Vida
programme.desc: Mickey é uma advogada que tenta recuperar a relação disfuncional que tem com o seu pai, um prestigiado mas envelhecido olheiro de basebol, acompanhando-o numa viagem de recrutamento que pode ser a ultima da sua carreira.

programme.title: O Homem Dos Punhos De Ferro 2
programme.desc: Quando Thaddeus, um estranho misterioso, recupera de ferimentos numa pequena vila na China do século XIX, envolve-se no conflito que coloca o povo do vilarejo contra o maldoso Mestre Ho e o nefasto clã Beetle. Com Thaddeus ao seu lado, o bem educado Li Kung transforma-se num guerreiro mortal.

programme.title: Sucker Punch - Mundo Surreal
programme.desc: Uma jovem é internada num hospício contra a sua vontade. Como estratégia para lidar com tudo, ela recua para uma extravagante realidade alternativa onde se junta a quatro prisioneiras que se tornam guerreiras experientes com a missão de recolher os quatro itens que lhes permitam fugir.

programme.title: Boss Level - O Último Nível
programme.desc: Preso num “loop” temporal que repete constantemente o dia que desemboca na sua morte, Roy Pulver, um antigo agente das forças especiais, empreende uma corrida contra o tempo para tentar acumular informação que evite o seu desfecho fatal e salve a mulher que ama.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Iolanta
programme.desc: ‘Iolanta’ and ‘Perséphone’ – A double bill consisting of two stage works that “represent an ideal of beauty, poetry and hope” forms this new production by Peter Sellars in Madrid from the Teatro Real from 2012. In both works, the progression from darkness to light acts as an initiation rite that completely transforms the existential attitude of the leading characters.

programme.title: The LSO performs Boulanger, Dalbavie And Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Polish conductor Marta Gardolinska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a concert program consisting of Lili Boulanger’s D’un Martin de Printemps, Marc-André Dalbavie’s Concerto for Flute, and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The luminous optimism of the young Boulanger is poles apart from the raw passion and white-hot melodies of Tchaikovsky’s semi-autobiographical symphony.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Schumann, Sibelius a. o.
programme.desc: Baritone Arvid Fagerfjäll (Sweden, 1991) and pianist Hikaru Kanki (Japan, 1993) perform ‘Lust der Sturmnacht’ from Robert Schumann’s Kerner-Lieder, Op. 35; ‘Le diable dans la nuit’ from Henriëtte Bosmans’ Dix mélodies; Franz Schubert’s Totengräbers Heimweh, D.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Overture-Fantasy Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Overture-Fantasy “Romeo and Juliet”. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras. Tchaikovsky based his composition on Shakespeare’s famous play “Romeo and Juliet”.

programme.title: Bach - Goldberg Variations (BWV 988)
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church, where Bach spent most time of his career as 'Thomaskantor', the musical director of the Thomanerchor church choir. The Goldberg Variations consist of one aria and a set of 30 variations.

programme.title: Brahms - Clarinet Sonata No. 2, Op. 120
programme.desc: Written in 1894, the two Clarinet Sonatas, Op. 120 are the last chamber music pieces Johannes Brahms composed. In this performance at Het Groene Paviljoen in Baarn, the Netherlands, clarinetist Henk de Graaf and pianist Daniël Wayenberg play Brahms’s Clarinet Sonata No. 2 in E-flat major, Op. 120.

programme.title: Hans van Manen – Moving to Music
programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. His over 150 ballets all bear his distinct signature, featuring a great clarity in structure, refined simplicity and an aversion to decorative frills.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 12
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 12. Written in 1837, the work is a set of eight piano pieces with contrasting moods.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 14, Op. 131
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. This symphony shows Beethoven’s loyalty to the model of Joseph Haydn’s and Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s late symphonies, yet reveals his attempt to distinguish himself from his predecessors.

programme.title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Piano Concerto No. 1
programme.desc: A colourful Christmas concert by the South Netherlands Philharmonic with Tchaikovsky’s famous First Piano Concerto. Chief conductor Dmitry Liss showcases, together with master pianist Boris Berezovsky, a true, Russian spirit. In such a way as to evoke what an American critic had said about one of his previous Tchaikovsky interpretations: “Liss expressed an absolute authority over the orchestra and the audience.

programme.title: Live in Aix-en-Provence
programme.desc: The shy and elusive Grigroy Sokolov is one of the greatest pianists of our time. His performances leave critics and audiences alike speechless, like they don't quite believe what they have just experienced. In 2015, he played a beautiful recital with works by Johann Sebastian Bach, Ludwig van Beethoven, Franz Schubert, Frédéric Chopin, and Claude Debussy that took place at the Festival La Roque D'Anthéron in Aix-en-Provence.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93. Beethoven wrote the work in 1812 upon completion of his Symphony No. 7. The composer conducted the February 27, 1814 première at a concert in Vienna that also included a reprise performance of his Symphony No.

programme.title: Tribute to Hans van Manen
programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. His over 150 ballets all bear his distinct signature, featuring a great clarity in structure, refined simplicity and an aversion to decorative frills. In this tribute to the great choreographer, dancers of the Dutch National Ballet perform three masterpieces from Van Manen’s extensive oeuvre.

programme.title: Mosaïque Project - Canadian Piano Quartets
programme.desc: This very special concert event celebrates the diversity and richness of Canada through the eyes and ears of its people. Ensemble Made in Canada’s Mosaique Project features a commissioned suite of piano quartets by 14 Canadian composers, each inspired by a region of our vast country. Their album release and two-year National tour culminate in St. Catharines’ stunning Partridge Hall!

programme.title: Works by Mozart and Sarti
programme.desc: Italian conductor Mattia Rondelli conducts the Orchestra dell’Opera Carlo Felice Genova in a concert program consisting of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Giuseppe Sarti. Soprano Barbara Massaro is the soloist. On the program are Mozart’s Symphony No. 5 in B-flat major, K.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Martinu° - Concertino for Piano Trio and Strings
programme.desc: The Italian-Swiss ensemble Trio des Alpes, consisting of Hana Kotková (violin), Claude Hauri (cello), and Corrado Greco (piano), and the Orchestra da Camera di Mantova join forces in this performance of the Concertino for Piano Trio and String Orchestra, H. 232 by Czech composer Bohuslav Martin (1890-1959). Martin was a prolific composer, creating an oeuvre of almost 400 works.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2, Op. 36
programme.desc: In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt leads the Lucerne Festival Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway.

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel And Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Delibes - Lakmé
programme.desc: Frédéric Chaslin (1963) leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Opéra Royal de Wallonie-Liège in a performance of Léo Delibes’s tragic opera Lakmé (1883). Written to a libretto by Edmond Gondinet and Philippe Gille, the opera is set in nineteenth-century British India and tells the story of Lakmé, who falls in love with Gérald, a British officer.

programme.title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók’s best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s well-known Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. With Sir Simon Rattle's mischievous enthusiasm, this famous heavyweight symphony sounds new again. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90: - I.
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Danielpour - Elegies
programme.desc: Richard Danielpour (*1956) is one of the most beloved American composers of his generation due to his frequent referencing of and connection with the past, being inspired by American icons such as Aaron Copland, Samuel Barber and Leonard Bernstein. His lush musical language is often infused with swingy jazz rhythms just as is the music of Copland and Bernstein.

programme.title: Copland - Appalachian Spring
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Aaron Copland’s Appalachian Spring Suite. Originally commissioned as a ballet for the legendary dancer Martha Graham, Aaron Copland's Appalachian Spring (1944) has since become an American classic. While first scored for a thirteen-piece ensemble, Copland later arranged the work for a full orchestra.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures!

programme.title: Beethoven - Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20
programme.desc: The soloists from the Lucerne Festival Orchestra present Ludwig van Beethoven’s Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20, which is scored for clarinet, horn, bassoon, violin, viola, cello and double bass. This 1799 piece achieved great popularity during Beethoven’s lifetime.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 14, KV 449
programme.desc: Regarded as one of the finest interpreters of Romantic repertoire, Francesco Attesti (*1975) gave his first recital at age 11 and by the time he was 23, had earned the highest honours in piano from Florence’s Conservatorio Luigi Cherubini. In this recording of his 2016 Deeply Mozart concert tour, Attesti performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s piano concertos KV 449 and KV 488 with the Italian OIDA Orchestra and conductor Paolo Belloli.

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 2, 14 And 16
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: Chopin - Ballade No. 1, Op. 23
programme.desc: Roberto Giordano performs Chopin's Ballade No. 1, Op. 23. The sketches of the work date back to 1831 during Chopin's eight-month stay in Vienna. The first ballade was completed in 1835 after the composer moved to Paris.

programme.title: Le Grand Orgue in Concert
programme.desc: Current holder of “Great Organ of the Notre Dame,” Olivier Latry began his musical career when he enrolled in Gaston Litaize’s organ class at the Academy of Saint-Maur at the age of 16. In 1985, at 23 years of age, Latry was awarded the post of one of four “titulaires des grands orgues” of Notre Dame, Paris.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 36 'Linz'
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing a charming work by Mozart, with a sentimental connection to the conductor: Symphony No. 36 'Linz is named after the hometown of Welser-Möst. Mozart wrote the piece when stopping over on a trip from Vienna to Salzburg. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in January 2022.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Mahler's 'Resurrection' Symphony, written between 1888 and 1894, is a colossal five-movement work exploring themes of death and resurrection. It was one of Mahler's most popular and acclaimed works during his lifetime, famously culminating in a powerful choral finale.

programme.title: J. S. Bach - Chamber music
programme.desc: Philippe Herreweghe conducts his Collegium Vocale Gent in this chamber music program dedicated to the music of J. S. Bach. On the program are Bach’s Orchestral Suite No. 4 in D major, BWV 1069; Gott der Herr ist Sonn und Schild, BWV 79; and Missa brevis in G major, BWV 236. The soloists are soprano Dorothee Mields, tenor Thomas Hobbs, countertenor Alex Potter, and bass Peter Kooij.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 5 BWV 1018
programme.desc: This Sonata for Violin and Harpsichord No. 5 BWV 1014 is the fifth out of the set of sonatas Johann Sebastian Bach composed before 1725, probably during his time as chapel master in Köthen. Presumably, he wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig.

programme.title: Sibelius – Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: In 2013, the Finnish conductor Hannu Lintu was appointed principal conductor of the Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra. Lintu studied piano and cello at the Sibelius Academy and the Turku conservatorium in Sweden’s southeast. He started conducting at the Sibelius Academy.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7.

programme.title: Galaxmphony - The Final Odyssey
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies — to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune, and many more. Join the orchestra on the third and final symphonic journey through musical universes and cinematic galaxies — all the way to the outermost asteroids and back to Earth again.

programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna).

programme.title: Fantasymphony - One Concert to Rule Them All
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program.

programme.title: The Four Seasons
programme.desc: We all know 'The Four Seasons of Vivaldi', it is one of the 'hits' of classical music. What if the Antonio Vivaldi’s famous Four Seasons had been preceded by those of Giovanni Antonio Guido, star violinist of Parisian orchestras of the maturity of Louis XIV?

programme.title: Misha Enzovoort
programme.desc: Misha Mengelberg, the forgetting has begun. He is waiting for a taxi he didn’t call to go to a performance that won’t take place. Dutch composer/pianist and grand duke of jazz Misha Mengelberg (1935) has been submerged in the shadow of dementia, ending his life as a musician. At the London jazz club Vortex in 2013 he impressively says his goodbyes to the international stage.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 97
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 21
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 79
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 40
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: Meu Campeão - Ep. 42
programme.desc: Kafkas, um jovem pugilista promissor, tem sua vida virada de cabeça para baixo com um infeliz incidente que o força a abandonar a carreira e se despedir dos ringues. Anos depois, ele retornará ao ringue por seu filho Günes e ficará por mais um assalto.

programme.title: Segure Minha Mão T1 - Ep. 93
programme.desc: A história gira em torno de uma garota chamada Azra, que está estudando no exterior, na América, para se tornar cozinheira profissional, assim como seu pai.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 99
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 23
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Ray Charles and the Raelettes - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson.

programme.title: Forró Series
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed and curated in São Paulo by director and presenter Dani Gurgel and producer and engineer Thiago Rabello, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: Tivoli Utrecht: Sven Hammond Soul
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the sound track of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Parisien meets Kühn And Portal
programme.desc: Since his first appearance at Jazz in Ramatuelle in 2010, saxophonist Émile Parisien has made his mark among the most talented musicians of his generation. On the soprano saxophone, his favorite instrument, he invented a unique lyrical style.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Episode 5: Chet Baker - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpet player and occasional singer Chet Baker (1929-1988) was one of the most popular exponents of bebop and cool jazz. At the age of 10, Baker was introduced to music in a school orchestra, after which he discovered bebop in the army in 1946. After serving six months in prison in 1953 for drug possession, Baker formed his own quartet with West Coast jazz great, pianist Russ Freeman.

programme.title: Betty Carter/Jazzmeia Horn, Please Do Something
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: Anita Oday Live in Sweden 1963
programme.desc: Anita O’Day?boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O’Day’s horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Live at the Office: BIGYUKI And Now vs Now
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Medley
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa’: a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo’.

programme.title: Episode 3: Miles Davis - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan.

programme.title: VEIN Plays Ravel
programme.desc: A sound support with provocative combinations, a modern music laboratory, a vehicle of inspiration whose importance has been proven by many high-profile collaborations. Music lovers who appreciate jazz for its ability to provoke and continuously question the status quo certainly do not expect that such a standard set in its configuration finds itself completely detached from tradition.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner Solo
programme.desc: Pianist McCoy Tyner’s artistry and innovation embrace a multitude of styles, from African and Latin rhythms to the modal harmonies of the post-bebop era. His amazing versatility has enabled him to excel in a wide variety of settings.

programme.title: Bobby McFerrin - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In 1985, American vocal virtuoso Bobby McFerrin took the stage solo at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Travellin’ Blues: Big Daddy Wilson
programme.desc: ‘Jazz en Baie’, a whining guitar sound, and the baritone voice of Big Daddy Wilson are the perfect recipe for an emotional and melancholy blues concert. As a young man, Big Daddy Wilson never saw a real blues concert before he walked into a Bremen club as a young soldier. This revelation drove the expatriate to throw himself head over heals into music.

programme.title: Jazz Batá 2
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: Sun Ra Arkestra - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1985, pianist and space-faring jazz icon Sun Ra and his Arkestra crash-landed at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Makoto Ozone - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1984, Japanese jazz pianist Makoto Ozone was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Antonio Faraò 4tet
programme.desc: Antonio Faraò features prominently in the rich group of talented Italian pianists. He is the winner of the 1998 prestigious Concours Martial Solal, awarded by Herbie Hancock, and he has made his mark as a player of elegance and lyricism. This has allowed him to collaborate with the best European and American musicians. In his album ‘Evan’, recorded in the USA, he leads an all-star band, notably starring Joe Lovano on tenor.

programme.title: Michelle David - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Orlando Julius
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Al di Meola - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1993, American guitarist Al Di Meola was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Burton Greene - OTO Part I
programme.desc: Legendary free jazz pianist Burton Greene rose to fame in New York City's free jazz scene of the 1960s. Exploring various spontaneous improvisational styles, Greene performs live at Cafe OTO in London, UK.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard And The Satchmo Legacy Live in 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. This concert of Freddie Hubbard and the Satchmo Legacy in 1987, highlights the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone.

programme.title: Christian McBride - John Day
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Blicher Hemmer Gadd - A Music documentary
programme.desc: Award-winning saxophonist Michael Blicher, Hammond wizard Dan Hemmer and legendary drummer Steve Gadd joined forces in 2014 to celebrate their shared love for Hammond-organ soul jazz. The band, which tours extensively throughout the world, has released several albums. Their third album, which was released in November 2019, features U.K. vocalist Paul Carrack on the soulful ballad 'The First One To Know'.

programme.title: Rhoda Scott And La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. 'It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater: Motherland
programme.desc: Singer Dee Dee Bridgewater walks in with considerable credentials, but this documentary related to her album ‘Red Earth’ trumps them all: Red Earth is a Malian journey that merges and melts all borders. While world-beat listeners will recognize the grooves, this is Bridgewater's first time bringing her own experiences as an African-American woman back to the motherland. It results in a fusion of feeling, visions, and music.

programme.title: 'Long Tall Dexter' Live in '64
programme.desc: Dexter Gordon: Live in '63 And '64?features three concerts filmed in Holland, Switzerland, and Belgium that highlight the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. These shows feature legendary side musicians such as Art Taylor (drums) and Kenny Drew (piano), and jazz classics “Blues Walk”, “A Night In Tunisia”, “Body And Soul”, and others.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis: In This House, on This Morning
programme.desc: The final concert of the Münchner Klaviersommer 1992 was by Wynton Marsalis and his septet. The 31-years-young star trumpeter performed one of his own jazz suites to the sold-out Philharmonie, under the title of ‘In This House, On This Morning’. The concert covers every jazz style, in composition and improvisation, and in both small and grand forms.

programme.title: John Lewis: Piano Solo
programme.desc: Pianist John Lewis, co-founder and long-time leader of the legendary Modern Jazz Quartet, wrote jazz history with that band. His ability to blend classical forms with jazz improvisations singled him out as a unique artist, who was capable of transcending every musical barrier. When the Modern Jazz Quartet retired, John Lewis continued to work with other musicians and as a solo pianist.

programme.title: Teddy Wilson - Théâtre de l’Atelier
programme.desc: Decades after the 1930s swing era came to an end, one of its giants, pianist Teddy Wilson (1912–1986), kept the flame of this music alive during countless international concert tours. During a hectic spring tour of Europe, the acclaimed pianist appeared at Geneva’s Théâtre de l’Atelier on March 21, 1969.

programme.title: Smooth Series at NSJ: George Benson And Kenny G
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Aretha Franklin: A trip in Paris
programme.desc: Live Recording at the Palais Des Sports from 1977. Aretha Franklin performs songs like ‘Respect’, ‘You make me feel like a natural woman’, ‘La vie en Rose’ and ‘Singing in the Rain’.

programme.title: Keith Jarrett - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: Song for my Father
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chick Corea And Gary Burton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton Big Band - Kurhaus Scheveningen
programme.desc: The Kurhaus in Scheveningen is a grand hotel in the Netherlands renowned for attracting both royal and musical nobility. Doubling as a concert hall, it has been host to several heavy hitters, such as the Rolling Stones and Ike and Tina Turner. On August 2, 1983, American vibraphonist Lionel Hampton performed at the Kurhaus in Scheveningen.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Omar Sosa AfroCubano Quarteto
programme.desc: To call Omar Sosa an Afro-Cuban jazz pianist would only capture part of his true style. Because while he has always kept one foot firmly within the traditions of his native isle, this citizen of the world also shows an insatiable curiosity, tirelessly exploring music from around the world: from the Caribbean to India and from West Africa to the Arab World. Nothing seems to escape his thirst for discovery.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Stranger than Paranoia
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Count Basie - North Sea Jazz Part II
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Sing Jazz, Singapore
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017’s Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón’s performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who was a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Great Jazz Pianists
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964.

programme.title: Come Twogether ft. Benjamin Herman
programme.desc: Instead of children’s songs, the sound of jazz standards was always present. They practiced intricate drum rhythms instead of Bach etudes: Simon Oslender and Jérôme Cardynaals have jazz running through their veins! Under the name ‘Twogether’ both youngsters celebrate a very unique and soulful style of funky blues-jazz. They create a sound that leaves even renowned jazz artists speechless.

programme.title: Runtown - La Machine de Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Enjoy Runtown’s first concert in Paris, where the Nigerian superstar brings many guests to his show. One of the most talented Nigerian afrobeat scenes will make you rediscover his greatest hits. Nigeria is a very creative country when it comes to the music scene. Runtown is no exception. His first single, “Party Like It’s 1980,” paved the way for “Gallardo,” which caught the entire international scene's attention.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Zara McFlaren
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: The Way it Goes
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: What Is This Thing Called Love
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all-time, Stanley Gayetzky, famously known as Stan Getz emerged as one of the most significant musical forces in the world of jazz post World War II. With his distinctively warm and lyrical tone, Getz is fondly dubbed as ‘The Sound’ because of his singularity and musical innovations.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis Quintet - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, American trumpeter and composer Wynton Marsalis and his quintet performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Straight No Chaser
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Hypnotic Brass Ensemble
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: November Music 2017: Daniel Herskedal
programme.desc: Since 1993, the November Music Festival has been held every year at various locations in the Dutch city of 's-Hertogenbosch. Highlighting a variety of contemporary musical styles and contemporary composers, November Music is today one of the most important festivals dedicated to contemporary music in the Netherlands. Norwegian tuba player and composer Daniel Herskedal trained at the Trondheim and Copenhagen Music Conservatories.

programme.title: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Quartet - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1991, Cuban pianist Gonzalo Rubalcaba was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Lucky Peterson - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Melody Gardot at Château d'Hérouville
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: Nubiyan Twist - Music Meeting
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. In 2019, the band Nubiyan Twist performs at the International Music Meeting Festival.

programme.desc: Tempo para relaxar e descontrair com sons e imagens da natureza que acalmam e transmitem uma sensação de tranquilidade. Pode ser um bom momento para adormecer ou simplesmente contemplar e descansar.

programme.title: WCCB - Ep. 328
programme.desc: LIVE March 29th from the MGM Grand in Las Vegas, 6'5' Sebastian Fundora, the WBC Super Welterweight World Champion, defends against former Welterweight World Champion Keith Thurman. Fundora is coming off an emphatic win over Tim Tszyu, who he defeated to claim the title in March of 2024.

programme.title: BWF Martial Arts T10 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: This episode features highlights from the Men's Forms Championship at the ISKA US Open Championships held at Disney World, Orlando, FL, USA.

programme.title: Wide World Of Fights T3 - Ep. 47
programme.desc: This episode features a super middleweight brawl between top contenders Adonis Stevenson and Jesus Gonzales that includes a Knockout of the Year candidate, as well as kickboxing, sumo, arm wrestling and more!

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 19
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is a heavily-anticipated welterweight bout featuring Floyd Mayweather, Jr. and 'Sugar' Shane Mosley. The fight, which generated $78 million in revenue, was Mayweather's first title fight since his comeback from his first retirement. Also on the card, heavyweight Bermane Stiverne and two-weight world champ Marcos Maidana.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T11 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Show 2 featuring Hakuho, Myogiryu, Kotooshu and Kakuryu from the Aki basho, 2015.

programme.title: Bipolar Rock N' Roller T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A raw and unflinching account of Mauro Ranallo's decades-long struggle with Bipolar Affective Disorder. programme.title: Judo For The World T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode, we see the best of the Judo Grand Slam from Baku and the #2 world ranked fighter, Michael Korrell, talks judo.

programme.title: Les Évaporés
programme.desc: Eugène Laborde sollicite le GRDV après la disparition de sa petite-fille Manon, introuvable depuis cinq semaines. Majeure, Manon n’est pas recherchée par la police, bien qu’elle ait disparu en plein enterrement de vie de jeune fille. En enquêtant sur sa trace, Esther, Frankie et Douma voient ressurgir de vieux démons qui mettent Esther à rude épreuve.

programme.title: Les Évaporés
programme.desc: Samuel, journaliste au coeur d’un couple très exposé, disparaît soudainement après un étrange appel téléphonique. Le GRDV enquête à la demande de son épouse, mais se heurte à un entourage fermé et peu coopératif. Parallèlement, Esther compte utiliser Absi pour infiltrer un club privé et progresser dans l’affaire de la disparition de Mathias.

programme.title: Ça Commence aujourd'hui
programme.desc: Tous les jours, Faustine BOLLAERT accueille sur le plateau de « Ca commence aujourd’hui » des hommes et des femmes qui viennent témoigner sur une période de leur vie, un drame, une épreuve, un cap à passer ou un changement, et qui font souvent écho à de grands sujets de société. Entourée d'experts : psychologues, psychiatres, avocats, gynécologue, Faustine aide les témoins et les téléspectateurs à mieux comprendre ce qu’ils ont vécu.

programme.title: Simon Coleman
programme.desc: Lors d'une exhibition d'échecs à Aix-en-Provence, le jeune prodige Julien Roussel s'effondre en pleine partie et meurt sous les yeux du public. Très vite, Simon Coleman soupçonne un empoisonnement. Pour les besoins de l'enquête, Simon plonge dans l'univers feutré des grands maîtres et découvre qu'ici, non seulement chaque coup est calculé, mais que la moindre erreur peut être fatale...

programme.title: Capitaine Marleau
programme.desc: Une femme est retrouvée morte à bord du bac qui relie les deux berges du fleuve. Face à Marleau les pistes se multiplient : le coupable serait-il le jeune Argann, tout juste évadé de prison et qui avait des raisons d’en vouloir à la victime ? A-t-elle été tuée parce qu’elle milite contre la construction d’un pont qui scellerait la fin du bac?

programme.title: Ça Commence aujourd'hui
programme.desc: Tous les jours, Faustine BOLLAERT accueille sur le plateau de « Ca commence aujourd’hui » des hommes et des femmes qui viennent témoigner sur une période de leur vie, un drame, une épreuve, un cap à passer ou un changement, et qui font souvent écho à de grands sujets de société. Entourée d'experts : psychologues, psychiatres, avocats, gynécologue, Faustine aide les témoins et les téléspectateurs à mieux comprendre ce qu’ils ont vécu.

programme.title: Escales en France
programme.desc: Ce magazine va nous faire découvrir les régions françaises en plongeant le téléspectateur au cœur d'une ville, d'un département français, d'une région, et lui fera découvrir son histoire, ses richesses patrimoniales, ses spécialités gastronomiques et ses lieux incontournables… Escales en France va à la rencontre de ces français agriculteurs, marins pêcheurs, artisans, restaurateurs, éleveurs, guides touristiques, tous amoureux fous...

programme.title: C'est Succulent!

Un duo intergénérationnel et gourmand à la découverte d'un terroir, de ses producteurs et artisans.

Ce concert réunit sur scène des amis fidèles de Frank Gehry, les chefs d’orchestre Esa-Pekka Salonen et Thomas Adès, ainsi que deux musiciens associés à la Fondation : le violoniste Daniel Lozakovich et la pianiste Yuja Wang.

programme.desc: Tibério fica sabendo que Levi procurou Muda. Tenório não gosta de saber que Maria Bruaca saiu para cavalgar com Alcides. José Leôncio fica feliz com a chegada de Jove e Irma. Sebastião conta a Virgínia sobre a embriaguez de Mirinho.

programme.desc: A Família Dumbo chega à Kanuca TV trazendo o retrato divertido e emocionante de uma família típica de Benguela, onde cada episódio transforma desafios do dia-a-dia em histórias cheias de humor, valores e identidade angolana. programme.title: Família Dumbo
